body.x: Lithiway Co. Ltd. (CEO Hyungmo Jeong) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will occur from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. Lithiway will exhibit its battery performance enhancer, "Energy-Elixir" (E-Elixir), at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Founded in September 2023 by Hyungmo Jeong, a professor of mechanical engineering at Sungkyunkwan University and an expert in investment, strategy, and tech marketing, Lithiway is a materials technology startup that aims to address critical challenges in the battery industry.

According to Lithiway, the electric vehicle and battery manufacturing industries are under immense pressure to develop high-performance batteries that meet demands for quality, cost-efficiency, and compatibility with existing production systems. “E-Elixir offers a simple additive solution to significantly enhance battery performance without requiring changes to existing production lines or equipment,” the company explained.

E-Elixir can be added in small quantities during any stage of the battery production process, such as cathode material synthesis, slurry mixing, or film manufacturing. This innovative approach improves performance while reducing production costs. It provides manufacturers a win-win business model that addresses performance, process, and price challenges.
At CES 2025, Lithiway plans to showcase E-Elixir and seek strategic partnerships and investors to facilitate its entry into global markets, particularly in the U.S. and Japan.

E-Elixir is a powdered additive that enhances battery performance when added in small amounts during production. Lithiway tested the product on three widely used high-nickel cathode materials, including NCM811. Results showed that adding just 0.1% by weight of E-Elixir to the cathode material increased battery lifespan by approximately 1.3 to 1.7 times.

The company emphasized that E-Elixir can be easily applied to various cathode and anode materials, including sodium-ion batteries (SIB) and next-generation batteries, making it a versatile solution for diverse industry needs.
Lithiway collaborates with a leading global battery manufacturer and a top electric vehicle producer under nondisclosure agreements (NDA) to develop practical applications for E-Elixir.

Looking ahead, Lithiway aims to establish global partnerships and expand into international markets, particularly in the U.S. and Japan. The company participated in the 2024 Tokyo Innovative Leaders Summit (ILS), where it held business meetings with top chemical, materials, and battery companies. According to Lithiway, several firms have entered discussions about potential collaborations.
By leveraging CES 2025, Lithiway seeks to highlight E-Elixir’s transformative potential and solidify its position as a leader in battery innovation.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
